Alternaria Leaf Spot.overview: Alternaria Leaf Spot is a destructive fungal infection that predominantly attacks cotton foliage during wet, humid weather, forming concentric necrotic rings and leading to premature defoliation.
symptoms: Small circular brown or purplish-brown spots on leaves (1-5 mm).
Lesions enlarge with characteristic 'target-board' or concentric ring patterns.
A pale chlorotic yellow halo typically encircles each necrotic spot.
Multiple spots coalesce into large irregular blighted patches causing leaf crinkling.
Severely affected leaves dry up, become brittle, and drop prematurely, reducing photosynthetic capacity.
immediate_actions: Isolate and mark infected field zones to monitor rate of spread.
Prune heavily infected lower leaves and safely destroy or bury crop residue outside the field.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; switch to drip or furrow watering to minimize canopy moisture.
Spray recommended protective fungicide within 48 hours if cloudy, humid conditions persist.
chemical_control: Mancozeb 75% WP: 2.5 to 3.0 g per liter of water (protective spray).
Propiconazole 25% EC: 1.0 ml per liter of water (systemic curative spray).
Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC: 1.0 ml per liter of water.
Copper Oxychloride 50% WP: 2.5 to 3.0 g per liter of water.
organic_biological: Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or cold-pressed Neem Oil (3-5 ml/L with emulsifier).
Trichoderma viride or Pseudomonas fluorescens: 5 g/liter foliar spray in the evening.
Cow urine (10%) mixed with fermented butter milk (sour chaas) as an immune-boosting bio-fungicide.
prevention: Treat seeds with Thiram or Carbendazim (2 g/kg seed) before sowing.
Maintain wider row-to-row spacing (90x60 cm or 120x45 cm) for optimal aeration and sunlight penetration.
Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer application, which causes succulent leaves prone to fungal spores.
Practice deep summer plowing to bury overwintering fungal spores in soil.
Alternaria Leaf Spot.favorable_weather: Warm temperatures (25-30°C) with continuous relative humidity above 80% and prolonged dew/rainfall.

hi.name: अल्टरनेरिया लीफ स्पॉट (पत्ती का धब्बा रोग)
hi.overview: यह एक फफूंद जनित रोग है जो पत्तियों पर संकेंद्रित छल्लों जैसे भूरे-काले धब्बे बनाता है और पत्तियां समय से पहले झड़ने लगती हैं।
hi.quick_advice: मैनकोज़ेब (2.5 ग्राम/लीटर) या प्रोपिकोनाज़ोल (1 मिली/लीटर) का छिड़काव करें और खेत में जलभराव न होने दें।

mr.name: अल्टरनेरिया पानावरील ठिपके
mr.overview: हा एक बुरशीजन्य रोग असून पाठीवर वर्तुळाकार तपकिरी ठिपके पडतात आणि पाने गळतात.
mr.quick_advice: मॅन्कोझेब (२.५ ग्रॅम/लिटर) किंवा प्रोपिकोनाझोल (१ मिली/लिटर) फवारावे.

gu.name: અલ્ટરનેરિયા પાન ના ટપકા
gu.overview: આ એક ફૂગજન્ય રોગ છે જેનાથી કપાસના પાન પર ગોળ ટપકાં પડે છે અને પાન ખરી પડે છે.
gu.quick_advice: મેન્કોઝેબ (૨.૫ ગ્રામ/લિટર) અથવા પ્રોપીકોનાઝોલ (૧ મિલી/લિટર) નો છંટકાવ કરવો.

Bacterial Blight.overview: Also known as Angular Leaf Spot or Blackarm, Bacterial Blight is a highly contagious bacterial vascular disease affecting leaves, stems, and cotton bolls.
symptoms: Small, translucent water-soaked spots on the underside of young leaves.
Lesions expand into sharply defined angular spots delimited by veinlets.
Spots turn dark reddish-brown to pitch black on the upper leaf surface.
Infection spreads along the main veins causing systemic 'black vein' necrosis.
Severe infections lead to stem lesions (Blackarm phase) and boll rot (Boll blight).
immediate_actions: Strictly avoid working in the field when plants are wet from rain or morning dew to stop bacterial transmission.
Sterilize farm implements with 0.1% sodium hypochlorite solution.
Immediately apply a combination of bactericide and copper fungicide to arrest lesion spread.
chemical_control: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (2.5 g/L) + Streptocycline (100 mg / 1 g per 10 L water).
Kasugamycin 3% SL: 2.0 to 2.5 ml per liter of water.
Copper Hydroxide 53.8% DF: 2.0 g per liter of water.
organic_biological: Foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens (10 g/L) to establish protective bacterial antagonism.
Garlic and ginger bulb extract (5%) foliar spray.
Neem cake soil amendment @ 250 kg/hectare during basal preparation.
prevention: Acid delinting of cotton seeds with concentrated sulfuric acid (100 ml/kg seed).
Seed treatment with Streptocycline (1 g/10 kg seed) soaked for 2 hours.
Select resistant hybrid varieties recommended by State Agricultural Universities (SAUs).
Rotate cotton with non-host crops such as sorghum, pearl millet, or maize for 2 seasons.
Bacterial Blight.favorable_weather: Intermittent rains, warm temperatures (28-34°C), and high relative humidity (>85%).

hi.name: बैक्टीरियल ब्लाइट (कोणीय पत्ती धब्बा / जीवाणु झुलसा)
hi.overview: यह जीवाणु जनित एक गंभीर रोग है जो नसों से घिरे कोणीय पानीदार काले धब्बे बनाता है और टहनियों को सुखा देता है।
hi.quick_advice: कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड (2.5 ग्राम) + स्ट्रेप्टोसाइक्लिन (1 ग्राम प्रति 10 लीटर) का छिड़काव तुरंत करें।

mr.name: जिवाणूजन्य करपा (अँग्युलर लीफ स्पॉट)
mr.overview: हा जिवाणूमुळे होणारा रोग असून पानांवर शिरांनी मर्यादित झालेले काळे त्रिकोणी ठिपके पडतात.
mr.quick_advice: कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराईड (२.५ ग्रॅम) + स्ट्रेप्टोसायक्लिन (१ ग्रॅम प्रति १० लिटर पाण्यात) फवारावे.

gu.name: બેક્ટેરિયલ બ્લાઈટ (ખૂણીયો ટપકા નો રોગ)
gu.overview: આ જીવાણુથી થતો રોગ છે જેમાં પાન પર ખૂણા આકારના પાણીપોચા કાળા ડાઘ પડે છે.
gu.quick_advice: કોપર ઓક્સીક્લોરાઈડ (૨.૫ ગ્રામ) + સ્ટ્રેપ્ટોસાયક્લિન (૧ ગ્રામ પ્રતિ ૧૦ લિટર) નો છંટકાવ કરવો.

Curl Virus.pathogen: Cotton Leaf Curl Multan Virus (CLCuMuV) transmitted by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci)
Curl Virus.overview: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV) is a devastating begomovirus that severely reduces cotton canopy, causing upward/downward leaf curling, enations, and stunted plant growth.
symptoms: Upward or downward cupping and curling of young terminal leaves.
Thickening and darkening of primary and secondary leaf veins (vein swelling).
Formation of small leaf-like outgrowths (enations) on the lower surface of leaves.
Stunting of the entire plant with shortened internodes and bush-like appearance.
Severe drop in square formation and small, malformed bolls with poor lint yield.
immediate_actions: Uproot and burn or deeply bury early infected plants (rouging) before flowering.
Target the whitefly vector immediately using systemic or translaminar insecticides.
Erect yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps per acre) across the field to monitor and catch adult whiteflies.
Clear weed hosts (Parthenium hysterophorus, Xanthium, Abutilon) around field borders.
chemical_control: Diafenthiuron 50% WP: 1.2 g per liter of water (for nymph and adult whitefly control).
Pyriproxyfen 10% + Bifenthrin 10% EC: 2.0 ml per liter of water.
Afidopyropen 50 g/L DC: 2.0 ml per liter of water (specialist whitefly feeding blocker).
Spiromesifen 22.9% SC: 1.0 to 1.2 ml per liter of water.
organic_biological: Spray 5% NSKE (Neem Seed Kernel Extract) or 10,000 ppm Azadirachtin @ 1.5 ml/L.
Entomopathogenic fungi: Beauveria bassiana or Verticillium lecanii @ 5 g/L during humid hours.
Conserve natural predators such as ladybird beetles, Chrysoperla carnea, and predatory mites.
prevention: Sow CLCuV-tolerant / resistant cotton hybrids adapted to your specific agro-climatic region.
Timely early sowing avoids peak whitefly population peaks during early vegetative growth.
Avoid growing alternative host plants (okra, brinjal, tomato, chillies) near cotton fields.
Maintain clean field borders free from broadleaf perennial weeds.
Curl Virus.favorable_weather: Hot and dry conditions with temperatures between 32-40°C that accelerate whitefly multiplication.

hi.name: कॉटन लीफ कर्ल वायरस (पत्ती मरोड़ रोग)
hi.overview: यह सफेद मक्खी द्वारा फैलाया जाने वाला बेहद खतरनाक वायरस है, जिससे पत्तियां ऊपर या नीचे मुड़ जाती हैं और पौधे की वृद्धि रुक जाती है।
hi.quick_advice: सफेद मक्खी पर नियंत्रण के लिए डायफेंथियूरॉन (1.2 ग्राम/लीटर) या पाइरीप्रॉक्सीफेन का छिड़काव करें और पीले चिपचिपे ट्रैप लगाएं।

mr.name: कापूस पाने चुरमुरणे (लीफ कर्ल व्हायरस)
mr.overview: हा पांढऱ्या माशीमार्फत पसरणारा विषाणूजन्य रोग आहे. पाने वाकडी-तिकडी होतात आणि वाढ खुंटते.
mr.quick_advice: पांढऱ्या माशीच्या नियंत्रणासाठी पिवळे चिकट सापळे लावा आणि डायफेन्थियुरॉन (१.२ ग्रॅम/लिटर) फवारा.

gu.name: કપાસનો પાન વળવાનો રોગ (લીફ કર્લ વાયરસ)
gu.overview: આ સફેદ માખી દ્વારા ફેલાતો વાયરલ રોગ છે જેનાથી પાન કોકડાઈ જાય છે અને છોડનો વિકાસ અટકી જાય છે.
gu.quick_advice: સફેદ માખીના નિયંત્રણ માટે ડાયફેન્થિયુરોન (૧.૨ ગ્રામ/લિટર) નો છંટકાવ કરો અને પીળા ચીકણા ટ્રેપ લગાવો.

Fusarium Wilt.overview: Fusarium Wilt is a persistent soilborne vascular disease that clogs xylem vessels, preventing water and nutrient translocation, leading to gradual yellowing, wilting, and plant collapse.
symptoms: Initial yellowing of leaf margins and interveinal areas starting from the lower leaves.
Leaves lose turgor pressure, wilt during sunny afternoons, and fail to recover.
Leaves turn brown, wither, and drop, leaving bare green or brown stems.
Cutting the main stem or taproot longitudinally reveals continuous dark brown or black vascular ring discoloration.
Stunted growth, delayed maturity, and mortality in patches across the field.
immediate_actions: Avoid inter-cultivation or tillage around wilting patches to prevent root wounding and fungal spread.
Isolate affected patches with clean drainage channels so irrigation water does not run through infected soil.
Drench soil at the base of wilting and surrounding healthy plants with systemic fungicide.
chemical_control: Carbendazim 50% WP: 2.0 g per liter of water (root drenching around plant base, 150-200 ml per plant).
Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP: 1.5 to 2.0 g per liter of water (root drenching).
Copper Oxychloride (3 g/L) + Streptocycline (1 g/10 L) drenching if combined with root rot complex.
organic_biological: Mass multiplication of Trichoderma viride / harzianum (2.5 kg mixed in 500 kg well-rotted FYM/compost applied per acre).
Soil application of neem cake @ 200 kg/acre to suppress soil fungal load and root-knot nematodes.
Apply vesicular arbuscular mycorrhiza (VAM) at sowing to strengthen root resistance.
prevention: Strict 3 to 4-year crop rotation with non-host crops like paddy, sorghum, or maize.
Grow wilt-resistant or tolerant cotton varieties and hybrids.
Treat seeds with Carbendazim (2 g/kg) or Trichoderma viride (10 g/kg seed) before sowing.
Control root-knot nematodes (Meloidogyne incognita) which create entry wounds for Fusarium.
Fusarium Wilt.favorable_weather: Soil temperatures of 25-32°C combined with high soil moisture followed by sudden dry spells, acidic/sandy soils.

hi.name: फ्यूजेरियम विल्ट (उकठा / मुरझान रोग)
hi.overview: यह मिट्टी जनित फफूंद रोग है जो तने के संवहनी तंत्र को बंद कर देता है, जिससे निचली पत्तियां पीली पड़कर पौधा मुरझा जाता है।
hi.quick_advice: कार्बेंडाजिम (2 ग्राम/लीटर) से पौधों की जड़ों में ड्रेन्चिंग करें और ट्राइकोडर्मा को गोबर खाद में मिलाकर खेत में डालें।

mr.name: फ्युझारियम मर रोग
mr.overview: हा जमिनीतून पसरणारा बुरशीजन्य रोग असून झाडाच्या खोडातील पाणी पुरवठा बंद होतो आणि झाड सुकून वाळते.
mr.quick_advice: कार्बेन्डाझिम (२ ग्रॅम/लिटर) ने आळवणी (ड्रेंचिंग) करा आणि ट्रायकोडर्मा शेणखतात मिसळून द्या.

gu.name: ફ્યુઝેરિયમ સુકારો (મર રોગ)
gu.overview: આ જમીનજન્ય ફૂગથી થતો રોગ છે જે મૂળમાંથી ઝાડની નસો બંધ કરી દે છે જેથી આખો છોડ સુકાઈ જાય છે.
gu.quick_advice: કાર્બેન્ડાઝીમ (૨ ગ્રામ/લિટર) નું થડ પાસે ડ્રેન્ચિંગ કરો અને ટ્રાઈકોડર્મા છાણીયા ખાતરમાં ભેળવી આપો.

Healthy Leaf.overview: The leaf exhibits uniform green chlorophyll pigmentation, intact epidermal structure, regular vein architecture, and no visible necrotic, viral, or chemical lesions.
symptoms: Uniform vibrant green color across all leaf lobes.
No spots, necrotic margins, water-soaked lesions, or chlorotic halos.
Firm, turgid leaf texture with natural flex and undamaged leaf veins.
Absence of insect webbing, nymphs, honeydew, or sooty mold deposits.
immediate_actions: No curative action required.
Continue regular weekly scouting across representative field transects.
Ensure balanced irrigation schedule avoiding both waterlogging and drought stress.
chemical_control: No chemical fungicides or bactericides needed at this time.
Maintain preventive schedule only if high pest/weather pressure is forecasted.
organic_biological: Apply prophylactic spray of 2% Panchagavya or Seaweed extract (2 ml/L) to enhance leaf vigor and immunity.
Continue beneficial microbial soil health maintenance (Jeevamrut / bio-fertilizers).
prevention: Maintain balanced N:P:K nutrient fertilization (do not overapply nitrogen).
Monitor canopy micro-climate and keep irrigation channels clear.
Maintain pheromone traps and sticky traps for early pest alert.
Healthy Leaf.favorable_weather: Moderate temperature (22-30°C), adequate sunshine, and optimal soil moisture.

hi.name: स्वस्थ पत्ती (Healthy Leaf)
hi.overview: कपास की पत्ती पूरी तरह स्वस्थ है और इसमें किसी बीमारी या कीट के लक्षण नहीं हैं।
hi.quick_advice: संतुलित पोषण और सिंचाई बनाए रखें। किसी कीटनाशक या फफूंदनाशक की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

mr.name: निरोगी पान (Healthy Leaf)
mr.overview: कपाशीचे पान पूर्णपणे निरोगी असून रोगाचे कोणतेही लक्षण नाही.
mr.quick_advice: योग्य खत आणि पाणी व्यवस्थापन सुरू ठेवा. कोणत्याही औषध फवारणीची गरज नाही.

gu.name: તંદુરસ્ત પાન (Healthy Leaf)
gu.overview: કપાસનું પાન એકદમ તંદુરસ્ત છે અને કોઈ રોગ કે જીવાતના લક્ષણ નથી.
gu.quick_advice: નિયમિત ખાતર અને પિયત જાળવી રાખો. દવાની જરૂર નથી.

Herbicide Growth Damage.pathogen: Herbicide Drift / Residual Phytotoxicity (e.g., 2,4-D, Glyphosate, Dicamba)
Herbicide Growth Damage.overview: Herbicide injury is non-parasitic chemical damage typically caused by spray drift from adjoining weedicide applications, contaminated spray tanks, or soil herbicide carryover.
symptoms: Strapped, elongated, shoe-string, or fan-like leaf lamina (typical epinasty from 2,4-D hormone drift).
Down-curling of leaf tips, thickened parallel venation, and cupped leaves.
Bleaching, chlorosis, or necrotic spotting if contact herbicides (e.g., paraquat/glufosinate) drifted.
Shortened internodes and bushy growth on newly emerging terminal flushes.
Damage is often unevenly distributed, concentrated along field borders or spray paths.
immediate_actions: Do NOT apply any more herbicides, defoliants, or harsh chemical cocktails.
Flush the crop with light, frequent irrigation to dilute soil chemical concentration.
Spray biostimulants (amino acids, humic acid, or seaweed extract) to alleviate plant physiological shock.
Inspect adjacent fields to identify drift source and prevent repeated contamination.
chemical_control: No chemical pesticide applies. Counteract physiological stress with:
Foliar spray of 19:19:19 (Water Soluble NPK) @ 5 g/liter of water.
Gibberellic Acid (GA3) @ 10-20 ppm (1 g per 50-100 L) to break hormone-induced stunt (if recommended locally).
Zinc Sulphate 0.5% + Ferrous Sulphate 0.5% + Urea 1% foliar spray.
organic_biological: Foliar spray of Seaweed extract (Ascophyllum nodosum) @ 2 to 3 ml per liter of water.
Amino-acid based bio-stimulants @ 2 ml/L to stimulate plant recovery enzymes.
Soil drenching with liquid humic acid (12%) @ 5 ml/L around root zones.
prevention: Never use the same spray tank for herbicides and insecticides/fungicides without triple rinsing with 1% washing soda.
Avoid spraying herbicides on windy days (wind speed > 8 km/h) to eliminate spray drift.
Use drift-reduction nozzles (anti-drift or air-induction nozzles) when applying weedicides nearby.
Maintain a 10-meter untreated buffer zone between cotton and herbicide-treated cereal plots.
Herbicide Growth Damage.favorable_weather: High wind conditions during neighboring weedicide sprays; extreme hot days accentuating chemical burns.

hi.name: खरपतवारनाशक का नुकसान (Herbicide Damage)
hi.overview: यह किसी कीटनाशक या खरपतवारनाशक (जैसे 2,4-D या ग्लाइफोसेट) के बहाव/छिड़काव से पत्तियों में हुई विकृति और खिंचाव है।
hi.quick_advice: कोई रासायनिक दवा न डालें। पौधे को तनाव से उबारने के लिए 19:19:19 (5 ग्राम/लीटर) और सीवीड अर्क (2 मिली/लीटर) का छिड़काव करें।

mr.name: तणनाशकाचा दुष्परिणाम
mr.overview: शेजारील शेतातून तणनाशकाचा (उदा. 2,4-D) फवारा उडाल्यामुळे पाने बारीक, वाकडी किंवा चोळामोळा होतात.
mr.quick_advice: झाडाची वाढ पूर्ववत करण्यासाठी १९:१९:१९ विद्राव्य खत (५ ग्रॅम/लिटर) आणि अमिनो ॲसिड / सीवीड अर्क फवारा.

gu.name: નિંદામણનાશક ની આડઅસર
gu.overview: બાજુના ખેતરમાંથી નિંદામણનાશક દવા (જેમ કે 2,4-D) નો પવનથી છંટકાવ ઉડવાથી પાન ખેંચાઈ જાય છે કે વિકૃત બને છે.
gu.quick_advice: ૧૯:૧૯:૧૯ ખાતર (૫ ગ્રામ/લિટર) અને સીવીડ એક્સટ્રેક્ટ નો છંટકાવ કરી છોડને રિકવરી આપો.

Leaf Redding.pathogen: Anthocyanin Accumulation due to Magnesium/Nitrogen Deficiency & Cold Stress
Leaf Redding.overview: Leaf Redding (Lal Patti) is a non-infectious physiological disorder in Bt cotton caused by heavy boll load, nutrient exhaustion (Mg/N/P), waterlogging, or sudden nocturnal temperature drops.
symptoms: Foliage develops a distinctive reddish-purple to bronze discoloration starting from leaf margins and interveinal tissue.
Lower and middle canopy leaves are affected first as nutrients are mobilized into developing bolls.
Veins may initially remain light green, presenting a contrasting reticulate pattern before turning entirely bronze.
Affected leaves turn brittle, suffer premature senescence, and shed, resulting in small bolls and premature opening.
immediate_actions: Provide quick supplemental foliar nutrition containing Magnesium Sulphate and Nitrogen.
Check soil moisture; avoid water stress during peak boll formation stage.
Scout for sucking pests (jassids/thrips) that accelerate reddening through sap-sucking injury.
chemical_control: Magnesium Sulphate (MgSO4): 10 g per liter of water (1% solution) foliar spray.
Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45): 10 g per liter of water (1% solution) for osmotic balance.
Urea (1-2%) + DAP (2%) foliar spray to rapidly restore leaf nitrogen and phosphorus.
If sucking pests are present, spray Flonicamid 50% WG @ 0.3 g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2 g/L.
organic_biological: Foliar application of Vermiwash (10%) or enriched Jeevamrut.
Spray 2% Cow milk + 1% jaggery solution as a natural micronutrient activator.
Application of fermented organic compost with bone meal/rock phosphate around plant root zones.
prevention: Apply basal dose of Magnesium Sulphate @ 20-25 kg per hectare during field preparation or split at 45 & 75 DAS.
Maintain optimum drainage to prevent root suffocation during monsoon surges.
Avoid nutrient depletion by applying split nitrogen and potash fertilizers during peak flowering and boll development.
Plant shelterbelts to reduce cold night winds during October-November.
Leaf Redding.favorable_weather: Sudden drop in night temperatures (<18°C) accompanied by high day temperatures (>32°C) during boll maturation.

hi.name: लाल पत्ती रोग (Leaf Redding / Lal Patti)
hi.overview: यह कोई फफूंद नहीं बल्कि मैग्नीशियम/पोषक तत्वों की कमी और ठंडे मौसम के तनाव से होने वाला शारीरिक विकार है।
hi.quick_advice: मैग्नीशियम सल्फेट (10 ग्राम/लीटर) और 13:0:45 पोटेशियम नाइट्रेट (10 ग्राम/लीटर) का 15 दिन के अंतराल पर 2 बार छिड़काव करें।

mr.name: कापसातील लाल्या रोग (Leaf Redding)
mr.overview: हा जमिनीतील मॅग्नेशियम, अन्नद्रव्यांची कमतरता आणि थंडीच्या ताणामुळे होणारा शारीरिक विकार आहे.
mr.quick_advice: मॅग्नेशियम सल्फेट (१० ग्रॅम/लिटर) + १३:००:४५ (१० ग्रॅम/लिटर) ची फवारणी करावी.

gu.name: કપાસ માં પાન લાલ થવા (લાલિયા રોગ)
gu.overview: આ કોઈ જીવાત કે ફૂગ નથી પણ મેગ્નેશિયમ અને પોષક તત્વો ની ખામી તેમજ ઠંડી ના કારણે થતો રોગ છે.
gu.quick_advice: મેગ્નેશિયમ સલ્ફેટ (૧૦ ગ્રામ/લિટર) અને ૧૩:૦:૪૫ (૧૦ ગ્રામ/લિટર) નો છંટકાવ કરવો.

Leaf Variegation.pathogen: Genetic Chimera / Calico Virus / Micronutrient Stress
Leaf Variegation.overview: Leaf Variegation is characterized by irregular patches of pale yellow, white, or albino tissue intermingled with normal green lamina, stemming from plastid genetic mutations, minor calico virus, or micronutrient chlorosis.
symptoms: Mosaic-like or patchy discoloration with distinct creamy-white, pale-yellow, and dark-green zones.
Patterns can be localized to a single branch or sector of the plant without rapid contagious spread.
Leaf shape is largely normal without heavy puckering or severe vein thickening.
Usually does not cause severe defoliation unless accompanied by secondary fungal infections.
immediate_actions: Inspect whether variegation is localized to isolated rogue plants or spreading uniformly across the plot.
If only 1-2 plants exhibit chimeric variegation, simply monitor without costly spraying.
If variegation is spreading alongside sap-sucking insects, test for viral transmission.
chemical_control: Chelated Micronutrient Fertilizer (Grade-IV or Grade-II): 2.5 g per liter of water.
Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4) 0.5% + Citric acid 0.1% to correct iron chlorosis mimicry.
If aphid or whitefly vector populations are high: Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.25 g/L.
organic_biological: Foliar spray of enriched bio-micro-nutrients (fermented with waste decomposer).
Application of wood ash or composted farmyard manure to supply trace elements.
Release Chrysoperla predators if sucking insects are detected.
prevention: Source certified, disease-tested F1 hybrid seeds from recognized government or authorized seed agencies.
Conduct balanced basal soil fertilization incorporating zinc, boron, and iron.
Avoid using self-saved seeds from previously abnormal plants.
Leaf Variegation.favorable_weather: Extreme alkaline or calcareous soils inducing micronutrient tie-up; sunny conditions highlighting pigment differences.

hi.name: लीफ वेरिगेशन (पत्तियों का चितकबरापन)
hi.overview: पत्तियों पर अनियमित हल्के पीले, सफेद और हरे रंग के धब्बे दिखते हैं जो आनुवंशिक कारण या सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्वों की कमी से होते हैं।
hi.quick_advice: चिलेटेड सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्व (2.5 ग्राम/लीटर) का छिड़काव करें। यदि केवल 1-2 पौधों में हो तो दवा डालने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

mr.name: पानांवरील रंगबदल / चितकबरेपणा
mr.overview: पानांवर हिरवे आणि पांढरे/पिवळे पट्टे दिसतात. हे सहसा जनुकीय किंवा सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्यांच्या कमतरतेमुळे होते.

gu.name: પાન નો રંગબેરંગી પટ્ટા વાળો રોગ
gu.overview: પાન પર સફેદ, પીળા અને લીલા ધાબા જોવા મળે છે, જે આનુવંશિક અથવા સૂક્ષ્મ પોષકતત્વો ની ખામીને કારણે હોઈ શકે છે.
gu.quick_advice: મિક્સ માઇક્રોન્યુટ્રિએન્ટ ખાતર (૨.૫ ગ્રામ/લિટર) નો છંટકાવ કરવો.

Verticillium Wilt.overview: Verticillium Wilt is a cool-weather vascular fungus producing characteristic 'tiger-stripe' interveinal chlorosis and leaf necrosis, leading to vascular browning and premature defoliation.
symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis giving the leaf a distinctive 'tiger-stripe' or mottled yellow-and-green appearance.
Leaf margins curl slightly and affected interveinal zones turn necrotic and brown.
Infection typically progresses from the bottom leaves upward as the crop matures.
Cross-section of the stem reveals olive-brown to dark-brown streaks in the vascular xylem tissue.
Foliage may dry and drop rapidly during sudden warm dry spells following cool, wet periods.
immediate_actions: Mark and isolate the affected field zones; avoid irrigating from infected rows into healthy areas.
Avoid cutting root systems during weeding or tilling near affected plants.
Drench root zones of border plants with systemic fungicide to inhibit microsclerotia growth.
chemical_control: Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP: 1.5 to 2.0 g per liter of water (soil drenching at plant base).
Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP: 2.5 g per liter of water (root drenching).
Fosetyl-Al 80% WP: 2.0 g per liter of water (foliar spray to boost systemic acquired resistance).
organic_biological: Soil application of Trichoderma harzianum or Bacillus subtilis (5 kg/ha in 500 kg FYM).
Green manuring with mustard or Brassica crops (bio-fumigation releases glucosinolates that kill microsclerotia).
Apply high doses of well-decomposed organic matter to stimulate antagonistic soil microbes.
prevention: Adopt deep summer plowing and soil solarization with transparent polyethylene sheets during May-June.
Crop rotation with immune non-host crops (corn, sorghum, pearl millet) for at least 3 years.
Maintain adequate potassium fertilization, which strengthens xylem vessel resistance to fungal penetration.
Plant tolerant cotton cultivars and avoid high plant density in fields with a history of wilt.
Verticillium Wilt.favorable_weather: Moderate or cool temperatures (20-25°C) combined with high soil moisture and alkaline soil pH (>7.5).

hi.name: वर्टिसिलियम विल्ट (बाघ जैसी धारियां / मुरझान रोग)
hi.overview: यह मिट्टी जनित फफूंद रोग है जो पत्तियों पर बाघ जैसी पीली-हरी धारियां बनाता है और पौधे के संवहनी तने को भूरा कर देता है।
hi.quick_advice: थायोफेनेट मिथाइल (1.5 ग्राम/लीटर) से जड़ों में ड्रेन्चिंग करें और पोटाश खाद की पर्याप्त मात्रा दें।

mr.name: व्हर्टिसिलियम मर रोग
mr.overview: पानांच्या शिरांमधील भाग पिवळा पडून वाघाच्या अंगावरील पट्ट्यासारखा दिसतो आणि खोडाच्या आत काळपट तपकिरी रंग येतो.
mr.quick_advice: थायोफिनेट मिथाईल (१.५ ग्रॅम/लिटर) चे मुळांशी आळवणी करा.

gu.name: વર્ટીસીલીયમ સુકારો
gu.overview: આ રોગમાં પાનની નસો વચ્ચે વાઘ જેવી પીળી-લીલી પટ્ટીઓ પડે છે અને થડ ની અંદર કાળો-કથ્થાઈ રંગ થઈ જાય છે.
gu.quick_advice: થાયોફેનેટ મિથાઇલ (૧.૫ ગ્રામ/લિટર) નું મૂળ પાસે ડ્રેન્ચિંગ કરો.
